name: email-routing-template
description: Route incoming email to a verified destination with an Email Routing Worker.

ROUTE_ADDRESS.description: The Email Routing address shown on the setup page. Keep it in sync with the top-level addresses configuration.

FORWARD_TO.description: A verified Email Routing destination address that receives forwarded messages.

ALLOWED_SENDERS.description: A comma-separated list of sender addresses allowed to use this route.
